answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed cave-guide season inside one named karst cave, where the guide leads tours through its crystal chambers and the park authority logs every visit. At unpredictable hours a whisper carries a one-time code over the cave radio, and the holder must repeat it live from inside it within minutes, so one operator cannot staff two caves at once. The fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real cave season, another licensed guide, another live human, and twice the prior fee.
